old_caption: The video captures a nighttime scene at a marina, where fireworks light up the dark sky above the water. The fireworks display is dynamic, with bursts expanding outward from their points of origin. The reflections of these fireworks shimmer on the calm surface of the water below. In the background, buildings and structures along the marina's edge are faintly illuminated by artificial lights. Several boats are docked along the pier, their silhouettes standing out against the night. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a vibrant nighttime scene at a marina, where fireworks light up the dark sky above the water. The fireworks display is dynamic, with bursts of colors—primarily white and blue—expanding outward from their points of origin. The reflections of these fireworks shimmer on the calm surface of the water below, creating a mirror-like effect that enhances the visual spectacle. In the background, a row of buildings and structures along the marina's edge are faintly illuminated by artificial lights, adding depth to the scene. Several boats are docked along the pier, their silhouettes standing out against the night. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, allowing viewers to fully absorb the beauty and scale of the fireworks display against the tranquil backdrop of the marina.
caption: The video captures a night harbor scene where three firework displays hang in a dark sky above a silhouetted shoreline. Low buildings, moored boats, and a row of warm quay lights line the water, their reflections shimmering on the calm surface. On the left, a spherical burst of purple dots trails short white sparks that lengthen and drift downward, while faint vertical trails occupy the center. On the right, a dome of purple dots remains largely stationary above a fan of white streaks that grow longer, brighter, and more spread as the sparks descend. The water reflections beneath the right and central bursts become noticeably more defined as the white trails extend, while the shoreline lights and building silhouettes stay fixed. Overall, the purple shells thin out and the bursts dim slightly as the fireworks continue their slow fall and fade.
